hint: Which terms here are the same kind, and which one stands alone?

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Think of $y$ as a box. You have $5$ boxes, give away $2$ boxes, and also have $3$ loose items. The loose items cannot go into the box count.
Which terms here are the same kind, and which one stands alone?
The terms $5y$ and $2y$ are alike, so subtract their coefficients: $5 - 2$. The $+3$ stays as it is.

explanation: $5y$ and $2y$ are like terms because both have the variable $y$.
Subtract their coefficients to combine them: $5y - 2y = 3y$.
The constant $3$ has no variable, so it cannot be combined with $3y$.
The simplified expression is $3y + 3$, with two unlike terms left.
